'''Jakke Clamont''', a park ranger, became a [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Big game hunter/Legends|big game hunter]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. In his [[Time/Legends|time]] as a hunter, he worked for gangsters, [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] leaders, and companies. Clamont was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and Galactic Empire and at one point dealt with the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Prengahl Kreen]].

==Biography==
Jakke Clamont was an individual who worked as a park ranger at reserve operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. He held his job for many years until he decided he would prefer to hunt creatures instead of protecting them&mdash;a more dangerous job. Clamont became a [[Big game hunter/Legends|big game hunter]], travelling across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] wrangling its fiercest predators back to research laboratories and [[Zoo/Legends|zoos]].<ref name="H&R" />

Throughout his new career, he took up jobs for executives for the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], gangster kingpins, Imperial leaders, and pharmaceutical and zoo companies. In one instance, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the Empire and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Clamont dealt with [[Prengahl Kreen]], an [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] operating out of the [[Empartheca system/Legends|Empartheca system]]<ref name="H&R" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>  The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] presented a large [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] new to the hunter.<ref name="H&R" />

==Equipment==
Clamont several weapons, such as a [[sporting blaster rifle]], a [[Sporting blaster/Legends|sporting blaster pistol]], and a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. He donned outdoor [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and used [[Syntherope/Legends|synthrope]], a [[Water filtration kit|water purification kit]], [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] and a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]].<ref name="H&R" />
